# Noah Jervis

Noah Jervis has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 8](https://flow.je/elections/district-8), representing [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/22/ready-to-fight-for-change-youngest-reform-jersey-candidate-confirms-st-clement-bid/)\]
